# ControlX · 智控引擎
## ControlX · 智控引擎
**AI Resource Optimization Engine**
> Make AI Work Smarter, Not Harder.
An intelligent optimization engine for AI Agents, improving task efficiency through adaptive reasoni
ng, context optimization, caching, and resource orchestration.
Adaptive Reasoning：Pick the reasoning depth a task actually needs instead of always paying for the d

eepest mode.
Context Optimization：Pass only the information a task needs, cutting repeated history,

repeated files and dead context.
Intelligent Orchestration：Coordinate main agents, subagents, models

and resources so work finishes with less churn.
Cache Optimization：Reuse results and cache instead

of recomputing or re-requesting them.
Quality & Efficiency：Optimise total resource use without tradi
ng away task quality.
Repository: <https://github.com/zhirai-tech/dsh-token-manager> · Author: ZHIRAI
**English** | 简体中文
**Token cost monitoring, model-call efficiency analysis, AUTO reasoning-effort scheduling and revers
ible context optimization for DeepSeek Harness.**
ZHIRAI · 智睿科技 · independent developer
| Dashboard | Live top strip | Compression records |
> Real screenshots from a running DSH desktop app: **left = plugin disabled**, **right = plugin enab
led** (same machine, only the plugin toggled). The A/B chart comes from a real model-call comparison
: **44,067 → 30,068 tokens (−31.8%) with identical answers**.
## What it is
A Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that answers five questions without touching Harness core, the
model adapters, the compression/statistics pipeline, or dsh-mnemon:
1. **Where did my tokens go?** Per-call four-bucket ledger, per task, session, project, today and al
l-time; input/output/reasoning/cache-hit/cache-miss split with explicit provenance (API value / esti

mated / missing).
2. **Which calls are wasteful?** 15 finding types: repeated file reads, repeated t
ools, repeated build/test/deploy commands, redundant confirmations, repeated plans/summaries, simple
-task step inflation, cache-hit drops, task-cost anomalies, subagent fork history, oversized delegat

ion prompts, usage gaps and more.
3. **What can be compressed safely?** Large shell/build/test/log o
utputs are replaced by structured summaries; the original is always recoverable via `token_manager_r

ead`; byte-identical repeated results are reused as tiny references.
4. **What did it cost and save?
** Cost per task with your price table, plus estimated tokens and money saved by compression/reuse.
5. **How much reasoning does this task need?** **AUTO reasoning**: picks `OFF / LOW / HIGH / MAX` pe
r task, escalates one level at a time on genuine reasoning failures, keeps manual levels untouched.
| Area | Capability |
| **Accounting** | Per-call four buckets (uncached input / cache read / cache write / output) + reas
oning-token provenance; deduplicated by `(session, turn, step, attempt)`; totals cross-checked field

-by-field against DSH's own `tokenUsage` projection. |
| **Efficiency analysis** | 15 finding types
with per-type switches and thresholds; 5 task types with same-type historical baselines (median / p8

0). |
| **AUTO reasoning** | Per-task classification (intent, files, modules, multi-cause, subagent)
, first step already at the selected level, `agent/pre-step` escalation on evidence, environment fai

lures never escalate, new task re-judges from scratch, manual selection exits AUTO. |
[该节后续省略]
## Measured (not marketing numbers)
| Scenario | Result |
| A/B, same command, compression off → on | **44,067 → 30,068 tokens (−31.8%)**, both answers identi

cal |
| AUTO vs manual HIGH (same A–D task set, real calls) | **1,063,769 → 620,623 tokens (−41.7%)*

*, cost −44.7%, latency −54.4%, same 4/4 success |
| Env-failure task (should not escalate): manual
HIGH misuse → AUTO | **617,106 → 147,417 tokens (−76.1%)**, cost −77.7%; AUTO stays LOW with holds |
| Task switch: after a complex task reached MAX, a new simple task | re-classified as **OFF**, no i

nheritance |
| Accuracy check, 1500-line output, ask line count + exact error line | Both modes answ

ered **identically and correctly** (1500 lines, exact L777 text, 1 ERROR / 1 WARNING) |
| Real 493k-
token session (offline audit of 12 shell outputs) | 521,347 B → 169,738 B (**−67.4%**), error/warnin

g lines preserved **20/20** |
| Historical projects, cumulative tokens avoidable (estimate) | large/
long sessions **30%–50%**, small projects **5%–15%** |
> A/B and AUTO rows are real model calls (DeepSeek `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`); costs use the
built-in reference prices, not a live bill. AUTO spends ~12% more than always-LOW — the price of ge
nuinely escalating on complex tasks — while saving 41.7% versus always-HIGH.
## AUTO reasoning (v1.4.0)
A compact **AUTO** control sits beside the composer model selector. Manual levels keep working exact
ly as before — picking one simply leaves AUTO.
| AUTO vs manual (same A–D task set, real calls) | Manual HIGH | AUTO | Change |
[该节后续省略]
### Requirements
DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`), Node.js 24.x bundled with DSH, no network acces
s `0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`), Node.js 24.x bundled with DSH, no network access, no API keys.
## Compatibility and safety
- **No core changes**: no edits to DeepSeek Harness source, dsh-mnemon, model adapters or the compre
ssion/statistics pipeline. AUTO changes the per-request reasoning effort only through the documented

`agent.model.select()` API, and only while the user has AUTO enabled.
- **dsh-mnemon coexistence**:
messages injected by mnemon (`source.kind = "dsh-mnemon"`) are classified as *protected* and never

compressed, deduplicated or removed (verified with real conversations; message hashes unchanged).
-
**Local-only data**: `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-token-manager\` (SQLite + content-addressed blobs); no telemetr

y, no network calls.
- **HTTP boundary**: every request goes through DSH's connection fence; `token_

manager_read` validates session ownership and confines path reads to the session workspace.
- **Reve
rsible**: uninstall removes listeners, routes, tool and UI; data remains until you delete it.
